method: Three serial cohorts: lane8, lane1, lane8 recheck; all use the same private lane executable and final production build.
Captured BR1 Tile IR, typed inputs, FP64 reference/bounds and complete manifests are identical. Only IR analysis wall time is ignored.
Explicit fast math, T128/P2/U8/cachefalse and full numerical bounds are fixed. Existing lane ownership is the only requested change; unordered SUM association may change.
Requested lane and unroll equal the actual emitted GroupPlan fields; all 100 graph nodes, loaded function/module, binding permutation, geometry and final typed pointers are checked.
Original numerical/finite/guard/readonly receipts and full saved-output checks are required independently of speed.
Driver registers/shared/local/max-threads are compiled attributes, not measured occupancy, traffic or causes of performance.
All seven raw samples and negative results are retained. No fitting, trimming, speed-based admission or historical timing denominator.
No Torch measurement or ratio is present. An improvement here alone does not establish superiority to native Tile or Torch.
telemetry_scope: Whole-stage telemetry includes compilation, upload, warmup and measurement; no causal attribution.
